# Работа в DRIP Недвижимость

Это рабочее место аналитика недвижимости: Go backend, React/TypeScript frontend, PostgreSQL. Application содержит правила и порты, adapters связывают их с HTTP и хранилищем.

- Начни с существующей публичной операции и ее тестов.
- Источник HTTP-контракта - api/openapi.yaml. После изменения выполни `make generate PNPM=pnpm`: он обновляет Go и TypeScript. Generated-файлы вручную не редактируют.
- Реализация HTTP находится в backend/internal/adapters/httpapi. Используй имеющиеся сервисы application и обычный JSON-формат ошибок.
- Проверяй новую операцию через публичный NewHandler и новые тесты. Существующие тесты сохраняй.
- Во время этой небольшой задачи достаточно `cd backend && go test ./internal/adapters/httpapi ./internal/application -count=1` и генерации контрактов. Полную make verify-fast в агентском прогоне не запускай.
- Перед обычным релизом выполняются `make verify-fast`, `make e2e` и проверяется Validate в GitHub Actions. Production deployment не настроен.
- Правила хранятся в application, работа с SQL - в PostgreSQL adapter. Для новой операции сначала проверь существующие порты.
- Схема БД находится в backend/internal/adapters/postgres/migrations. Реальные данные не используй; тесты работают с синтетическими данными и подменами портов.
- Go форматируй gofmt. Не вводи зависимости без необходимости.
- В отчете разделяй выполненные проверки и непроверенное. Внешний проверяющий запускает полный набор отдельно.

package httpapi_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/SinDenis/drip-real-estate-demo/backend/internal/adapters/httpapi"
	"github.com/SinDenis/drip-real-estate-demo/backend/internal/application"
)

func TestReadyReportsAvailableDependencies(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()

	handler := newHandler(staticProbe{})
	request := httptest.NewRequestWithContext(t.Context(), http.MethodGet, "/health/ready", nil)
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()

	handler.ServeHTTP(response, request)

	if response.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("status = %d, want %d", response.Code, http.StatusOK)
	}
	assertStatus(t, response, "ready")
}

func TestReadyReportsUnavailableDependency(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()

	handler := newHandler(staticProbe{err: errors.New("storage unavailable")})
	request := httptest.NewRequestWithContext(t.Context(), http.MethodGet, "/health/ready", nil)
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()

	handler.ServeHTTP(response, request)

	if response.Code != http.StatusServiceUnavailable {
		t.Fatalf("status = %d, want %d", response.Code, http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
	}
	assertStatus(t, response, "not_ready")
}

func TestLivenessDoesNotDependOnInfrastructure(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()

	handler := newHandler(staticProbe{err: errors.New("database unavailable")})
	request := httptest.NewRequestWithContext(t.Context(), http.MethodGet, "/health/live", nil)
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()

	handler.ServeHTTP(response, request)

	if response.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("status = %d, want %d", response.Code, http.StatusOK)
	}
	assertStatus(t, response, "live")
}

func TestMalformedRequestUsesThePublicErrorEnvelope(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()

	handler := newHandler(staticProbe{})
	request := httptest.NewRequestWithContext(
		t.Context(), http.MethodPost, "/api/v1/auth/login", strings.NewReader("{"),
	)
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()

	handler.ServeHTTP(response, request)

	if response.Code != http.StatusBadRequest {
		t.Fatalf("status = %d, want %d", response.Code, http.StatusBadRequest)
	}
	if contentType := response.Header().Get("Content-Type"); contentType != "application/json" {
		t.Fatalf("Content-Type = %q, want application/json", contentType)
	}
	var body struct {
		Error struct {
			Code string `json:"code"`
		} `json:"error"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(response.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("decode malformed request response: %v", err)
	}
	if body.Error.Code != "validation_failed" {
		t.Fatalf("error code = %q, want validation_failed", body.Error.Code)
	}
}

// Package httpapi adapts application operations to the strict OpenAPI contract.
package httpapi

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"log/slog"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"time"

	"github.com/SinDenis/drip-real-estate-demo/backend/internal/adapters/httpapi/generated"
	"github.com/SinDenis/drip-real-estate-demo/backend/internal/application"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

// Dependencies contains the application services exposed over HTTP.
type Dependencies struct {
	Readiness         application.ReadinessService
	Access            *application.AccessService
	Catalog           *application.CatalogService
	Sessions          *application.AnalyticalSessionService
	CurrentCollection *application.CurrentCollectionService
	SecureCookies     bool
	Logger            *slog.Logger
}

func (service server) Login(
	ctx context.Context,
	request generated.LoginRequestObject,
) (generated.LoginResponseObject, error) {
	if request.Body == nil {
		return loginUnauthorized(), nil
	}
	session, err := service.dependencies.Access.Login(
		ctx, request.Body.Login, request.Body.Password, clientIP(ctx),
	)
	if response := loginAccessError(err); response != nil {
		return response, nil
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	user, err := currentUser(session.Account)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	cookie := service.sessionCookie(session.RawToken, 12*time.Hour)
	return generated.Login200JSONResponse{
		Body:    user,
		Headers: generated.Login200ResponseHeaders{SetCookie: &cookie},
	}, nil
}

func (service server) ChangePassword(
	ctx context.Context,
	request generated.ChangePasswordRequestObject,
) (generated.ChangePasswordResponseObject, error) {
	if request.Body == nil {
		return passwordValidationFailed(), nil
	}
	session, err := service.dependencies.Access.ChangeTemporaryPassword(
		ctx,
		cookieValue(request.Params.AdSession),
		request.Body.Password,
	)
	if response := passwordChangeAccessError(err); response != nil {
		return response, nil
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	user, err := currentUser(session.Account)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	cookie := service.sessionCookie(session.RawToken, 12*time.Hour)
	return generated.ChangePassword200JSONResponse{
		Body:    user,
		Headers: generated.ChangePassword200ResponseHeaders{SetCookie: &cookie},
	}, nil
}

func (service server) Logout(
	body generated.ErrorResponse,
) {
	payload, err := json.Marshal(body)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(response, "internal server error", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	response.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	response.Header().Set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
	response.WriteHeader(status)
	_, _ = response.Write(append(payload, '\n'))
}

func (server) GetLiveness(
	context.Context,
	generated.GetLivenessRequestObject,
) (generated.GetLivenessResponseObject, error) {
	return generated.GetLiveness200JSONResponse{Status: generated.Live}, nil
}

func (service server) GetReadiness(
	ctx context.Context,
	_ generated.GetReadinessRequestObject,
) (generated.GetReadinessResponseObject, error) {
	if err := service.dependencies.Readiness.Check(ctx); err != nil {
		return generated.GetReadiness503JSONResponse{Status: generated.NotReady}, nil
	}
	return generated.GetReadiness200JSONResponse{Status: generated.Ready}, nil
}

func (service server) sessionCookie(raw string, lifetime time.Duration) string {
	cookie := http.Cookie{
		Name: "ad_session", Value: raw, Path: "/", HttpOnly: true,
		Secure: service.dependencies.SecureCookies, SameSite: http.SameSiteLaxMode,
	}
	if lifetime < 0 {
		cookie.MaxAge = -1
		cookie.Expires = time.Unix(1, 0)
	} else {
		cookie.MaxAge = int(lifetime.Seconds())
		cookie.Expires = time.Now().Add(lifetime).UTC()
	}
	return cookie.String()
}

func currentUser(account application.Account) (generated.CurrentUser, error) {
SHELL := /bin/bash
.DEFAULT_GOAL := help

PNPM := npx --yes pnpm@11.25.0
DOCKER ?= $(shell if command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then command -v docker; elif [ -x /Applications/Docker.app/Contents/Resources/bin/docker ]; then printf /Applications/Docker.app/Contents/Resources/bin/docker; else printf docker; fi)
COMPOSE := "$(DOCKER)" compose --file compose.yaml
BACKEND_MAKE := $(MAKE) --no-print-directory --directory=backend
FRONTEND_MAKE := $(MAKE) --no-print-directory --directory=frontend

override FILE := $(value FILE)
override KEY := $(value KEY)

.PHONY: help bootstrap generate test test-backend test-frontend lint architecture coverage \
	coverage-backend coverage-frontend build verify-fast verify e2e dev-up dev-down \
	doctor logs logs-service db-shell db-query s3-ls s3-get s3-put

help: ## Show available development commands.
	@awk 'BEGIN {FS = ":.*## "} /^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+:.*## / {printf "  %-20s %s\n", $$1, $$2}' $(MAKEFILE_LIST)

	$(FRONTEND_MAKE) bootstrap

generate: ## Regenerate Go and TypeScript code from OpenAPI.

	$(FRONTEND_MAKE) generate

test: test-backend test-frontend ## Run native unit and contract tests.

	bash tests/eiszhs-probe_test.sh

	$(BACKEND_MAKE) test

test-frontend: ## Run TypeScript and React unit tests.
	$(FRONTEND_MAKE) test

lint: ## Run Go, TypeScript, formatting, and shell checks.

	$(FRONTEND_MAKE) lint

architecture: ## Enforce backend and frontend dependency boundaries.
	$(BACKEND_MAKE) architecture
	$(FRONTEND_MAKE) architecture

build: ## Build the production backend binary and frontend assets natively.

	$(FRONTEND_MAKE) build

verify-fast: bootstrap generate lint architecture test coverage build ## Run all checks that do not require Docker.

	node_version="$$(node --version)"; \
	pnpm_version="$$(cd frontend && $(PNPM) --version)"; \
	docker_version="$$("$(DOCKER)" --version)"; \

	printf 'tools[5]{name,version}:\n'; \
	printf '  go,"%s"\n' "$$go_version"; \
	printf '  node,"%s"\n' "$$node_version"; \
	printf '  pnpm,"%s"\n' "$$pnpm_version"; \
	printf '  docker,"%s"\n' "$$docker_version"; \
	printf '  compose,"%s"\n' "$$compose_version"

logs: ## Follow the last 200 structured log events from the local stack.

logs-service: ## Follow one service. Usage: make logs-service SERVICE=app
	@case "$${SERVICE:-}" in \
		""|*[!a-zA-Z0-9_-]*|[-_]*) \

			exit 2; \
		;; \
	esac
	$(COMPOSE) logs --follow --tail=200 "$${SERVICE}"

db-shell: ## Open psql in the isolated local PostgreSQL container.

db-query: ## Run a local SQL query. Usage: make db-query QUERY='select now()'
	@test -n "$${QUERY:-}" || { \

		exit 2; \

	$(COMPOSE) exec --no-TTY postgres psql --no-psqlrc --csv --quiet --username analytics --dbname analytics --set ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --command "$${QUERY}"

		printf 'bin: "make s3-get"\nerror:\n  code: usage_error\n  message: "KEY is required"\nhelp: "Run make s3-get KEY=path/to/object"\n'; \
		exit 2; \
	}
	$(COMPOSE) --profile tools run --rm aws s3 cp "s3://analytics/$${KEY}" -

s3-put: ## Upload a workspace file locally. Usage: make s3-put FILE=tmp/a KEY=a
	@test -n "$${FILE:-}" && test -n "$${KEY:-}" || { \

		exit 2; \
	}
	@case "$${FILE}" in \

			printf 'bin: "make s3-put"\nerror:\n  code: usage_error\n  message: "FILE must stay inside the workspace"\nhelp: "Pass a repository-relative file path"\n'; \

	$(COMPOSE) --profile tools run --rm aws s3 cp "/workspace/$${FILE}" "s3://analytics/$${KEY}"
